events.title: Free Demo for Misohagi Crossing Is Now Available on Steam
events.summary: The free demo for Misohagi Crossing is now available on Steam! Misohagi Crossing is a story-driven horror mystery adventure set in a rural Japanese town. After seven years away, the protagonist returns to Yokomizo, his grandfather's hometown. There, he reunites with Sayo, the girl who was once his first love.
